descriptionChirho: The personal name Daniel/Daniy'el (meaning 'God is my judge'), referring primarily to the exilic prophet and wise man of the book of Daniel, and also to a son of David (1 Chr 3:1) and a postexilic priest (Ezra 8:2, Neh 10:7). All 52 occurrences represent the same proper noun with various prepositions (to, against, in/concerning): spa 'Daniel/a Daniel/contra Daniel,' arb 'دَانِياَلُ/عَلَى دَانِياَلَ/فِي دَانِياَلَ,' kor '다니엘이/다니엘에게,' swa 'Danieli/dhidi ya Danieli/kuhusu Danieli,' hin 'दानिय्येल/दानिय्येल के विरुद्ध.'
